So, how many days does it take to get to 27 feet?

Since each day the net gain is 1 foot, except for the last day. Wait, but if we're calculating up to 27 feet, then the number of days would be (27 feet) / (1 foot per day) = 27 days. Then on the 28th day, it climbs 3 feet from 27 to 30, and exits. So, total days would be 28?
